description: Use the owner-authenticated My Apps onion-import form for private key files; MCP refuses onion_import key material in tool arguments. Enter new build-secret values through the owner-authenticated My Apps build-credential form; MCP refuses raw new secret values. Never paste repository PAT/token values into chat or tool arguments; use the owner-authenticated Git-access form. These legacy schema fields document the underlying operation, not permission to send secrets through MCP. Deploy a custom app to an Impreza VPS. Choose exactly one mode: image (public Docker image via image), dockerfile (build from git_url or a retained context_id; local dir uploads only where advertised by this connection's input schema), manifest (a complete Docker Compose manifest object), or compose (reviewed self-contained YAML with compose_yaml, web_service, target_port and compose_review_id from impreza_prepare_compose; public images only). The hosted connector cannot stream a local directory; use Git or an archive already uploaded through a supported flow. Private Git repositories use git_auth_method=deploy_key or pat with git_pat. Always supply name, agent_id and mode. Never include credentials in source text: secret detection cannot inspect arbitrary source or configuration. Enter runtime secrets through the owner portal link.

build_secrets.description: Build-only secrets, encrypted at rest; 256 KiB total. Names are ASCII letters/digits/underscore, starting with a letter. Requires agent build-secrets-v1. npmrc is install-only; other names mount during npm build scripts. Dockerfile builds declare their own mounts. Build output is withheld; use trusted source. Never automatically inherited by previews.

build_strategy.description: static_files serves the selected project folder as plain static files with unprivileged Nginx: no build step, requires a regular index.html, no symlinks, up to 10000 files and 256 MiB; static_spa=false (default) returns 404 for unknown paths, true serves index.html; the fixed health check probes /index.html. go_build compiles one static binary with the pinned Go 1.25 toolchain from go.mod in the project folder (go.sum required when the module declares dependencies; read-only module downloads; no toolchain downloads, vendoring, workspaces or cgo), then runs it as a non-root busybox user; go_package selects the main package folder (default .). Default port 8080 (1024-65535). php_composer uses PHP 8.4/Apache and Composer 2, composer.json plus a matching composer.lock, public HTTPS archive dependencies and php_document_root (default public, containing index.php). Non-root runtime, default port 8080 (1024-65535), strict 2xx health. No scripts/plugins, custom repositories, private credentials, asset builds, migrations or .htaccess overrides. python_pip uses Python 3.13, a flat requirements.txt of PyPI packages and an explicit start_command. Non-root build/runtime; default port 8000. No dependency options/includes/URLs/local projects, system package installation or private build credentials. Compose 2.17+ and BuildKit required. node_npm generates a Node 24 npm server recipe. node_npm_static builds dist/index.html with npm and serves it with unprivileged Nginx and SPA fallback; requires build instead of start. Static runtime variables do not change browser bundles. Both require package.json and the selected manager lockfile (package-lock.json for default npm) in project_dir, and Compose 2.17+ with BuildKit. node_npm requires a production start script; node_npm_static requires a build script. Select npm workspaces with npm_workspace. build_secrets supplies credentials and node_package_manager selects pinned standalone pnpm/Yarn. Dockerfile is the default.

compose_review_id.description: mode=compose: analysis_id from preparing the exact YAML, service and port.

compose_yaml.description: mode=compose: reviewed self-contained Compose YAML. Run impreza_prepare_compose first. Public images only. Stored as a frozen manifest; redeploy reuses it.

context_id.description: mode=dockerfile: uploaded archive ID. Retained versions support redeploy. Mutually exclusive with Git, image, Compose and local dir where supported.

cpus.description: CPU limit (cores; 1.0 = one core). Default 1.0 server-side.

dir.description: mode=dockerfile: absolute path to a local project dir (tar+uploaded). Use this OR git_url.

dockerfile_path.description: Optional Dockerfile path relative to the source project root (default Dockerfile).

domain.description: Public hostname. Omit when onion:true for onion-only.

git_auth_method.description: Private-repo auth for git_url: none (default), deploy_key (SSH), or pat (token).

git_pat.description: Fine-grained, repo-scoped, Contents:Read token (required with git_auth_method=pat).

git_ref.description: Branch / tag / commit for git_url (default main).

git_url.description: mode=dockerfile: git repo to clone + build. https (public, or private with git_auth_method=pat) or SSH like git@github.com:owner/repo.git (deploy_key).

go_package.description: go_build only: main package folder relative to project_dir (default .), such as cmd/server. Up to 120 ASCII characters and five segments; no hidden or parent segments. Saved at creation and inherited by previews/redeploys.

healthcheck_path.description: node_npm, python_pip, php_composer or go_build only. Optional HTTP path such as /health (200 ASCII characters max). Checks 127.0.0.1 on target_port and requires 2xx without redirects. Omit for /: Python/PHP require 2xx; legacy Node accepts status below 500. Saved at creation; previews and redeploys retain it. A failed replacement recovers a verified healthy previous release; first installs keep the agent startup warning policy.

image.description: Required when mode=image. Public Docker image reference.

manifest.description: Required when mode=manifest. Full app manifest object.

memory_mb.description: Memory limit in MB. Default 512 server-side.

node_package_manager.description: Exact pnpm@10/11/12.x.y or yarn@4.x.y pin matching package.json packageManager, for standalone Node server/static recipes. Omit for npm. Requires its own lockfile; immutable install and Node 24. No npm_workspace or project manager configuration/plugins.

npm_workspace.description: Optional declared npm workspace relative to project_dir (the npm root). Keeps the root lockfile and sibling workspaces; builds workspaces in declaration order and starts the selected app. Static output is relative to that workspace.

onion.description: Also publish a Tor v3 hidden service. Default false.

onion_import.description: Provide BOTH C Tor key files, base64-encoded: hs_ed25519_secret_key (96 bytes) and hs_ed25519_public_key (64 bytes). One does not replace the other. Requires onion:true and preserves the existing onion address. Deploy-time only; impreza_add_onion does not import identities.

onion_profile.description: Requires onion:true. Standard uses intro-point rate limiting; hardened adds tighter limits and max streams; max adds experimental proof-of-work. Default standard. No DDoS guarantee; max is refused when the host's Tor lacks the PoW module.

php_document_root.description: php_composer only: public subfolder relative to project_dir, containing index.php; default public. Up to 120 ASCII characters and five segments; no hidden/parent/vendor/node_modules segments or symlinks. Saved at creation and inherited by previews/redeploys.

project_dir.description: Generated npm/Python/PHP recipes only: . (default) or relative app folder with its own package.json and lockfile, requirements.txt for Python, or composer.json/composer.lock for PHP. Use npm_workspace for shared npm roots. No hidden/parent/node_modules segments or symlink path components.

public_build_vars.description: Public values for npm run build only. Names start with VITE_, NEXT_PUBLIC_ or PUBLIC_; 20 keys max, 128 chars per key, 4 KiB per value, 16 KiB total. Values can appear in bundles/image metadata; never supply secrets. Saved at creation and inherited by previews/redeploys. Separate from runtime vars and npm install.

python_package_manager.description: python_pip may use pinned uv with pyproject.toml and uv.lock. Locked non-editable production install, public PyPI only, no workspaces or custom uv sources. Omit for pip.

require_healthy_start.description: Generated recipes only (node_npm, python_pip, php_composer, static_files, go_build; static_files and go_build use their built-in probe when no path is set). Require an explicit healthcheck_path to become healthy before deployment succeeds, including the first install. Requires agent 0.6.3+. Failed first installs remove containers and preserve volumes; eligible previous releases recover. Omit or false keeps legacy behavior. Saved at creation and inherited by previews/redeploys.

shield_profile.description: Impreza Shield profile for this app. Explicit off disables it. Omit for standard when the agent supports Shield, otherwise off.

standby.description: Create a custom cold standby on another server: same source as the primary, PINNED — mode=image requires the digest (name@sha256:…), a git build requires git_ref to be the exact 40-hex commit; uploaded Compose/context sources are compared by their frozen content. No public hostname or onion. Requires jurisdiction failover enabled and the agent startup-health-v1 capability; pair the two with impreza_pair_failover_standby.

start_command.description: python_pip only, required: production shell command, one line up to 1000 UTF-8 bytes. Example: exec uvicorn app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000. PORT and HOST are runtime variables. Do not include credentials. Saved at creation and inherited by previews/redeploys.

startup_timeout_seconds.description: Required healthy start only: 30-600 second startup observation budget, default 60; build/recovery time is separate.

static_output_dir.description: node_npm_static only: relative build output folder containing index.html, default dist. No hidden/parent/node_modules segments or symlinks.

static_spa.description: node_npm_static and static_files: true serves index.html for unknown routes; false returns 404. Default true for node_npm_static, false for static_files.

tor_egress.description: Opt-in Tor-only runtime egress for custom image/source builds. Requires SOCKS5 remote-DNS support and tor-egress-v1 agent capability. Direct runtime/DNS egress fails closed. Source fetch/build is not routed through Tor. No imported Compose or external service bindings.

vars.description: Environment variables to inject into the container.

web_service.description: mode=compose: explicitly selected HTTP service. target_port is its integer container port.

zero_downtime.description: Opt in to zero-downtime redeploys (from the first redeploy on): the new version starts next to the running one and takes traffic only after GET / answers HTTP 200-399; if it never does, the running version keeps serving. Only for a single-service app with a domain or onion, no host port and no writable volume (volumes refuse it). Makes the app proxy-only (no direct IP:port). Tune the readiness check later with impreza_set_zero_downtime. Needs agent 0.6.27+; older agents redeploy normally.

name: impreza_deploy_custom
title: Deploy custom app
